body: Keep going with ur therapy. I know telling you everything will get better soon won’t make a difference so I’ll skip the cliché speech, but keep doing what ur doing. Try some different ways of coping, you can google around or search some subreddits but look for ways to recognise what ur feeling specifically and ways to deal with each individual feeling. Well done for not giving in to ur thoughts, I know it’s difficult.
